example.title: Beach-front condominiums with gabled towers and red awnings
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A late-1980s six-storey condominium block near the beach: cream stucco with arched windows, steep cross-gabled roof towers, red fabric awnings on every window row, stacked balconies, palms in front. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
